title: vallaris clavata
intro: Vallaris clavata, commonly known as the 'Indian snail vine', is a plant species native to tropical regions of Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and as an antioxidant, as well as its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Vallaris clavata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating fever, sore throat, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been found to exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
